definitions: In a state of great suspense, excitement, or anticipation.
Eagerly awaiting the outcome of something.
examples: The thrilling movie kept everyone on the edge of their seats.
Fans were on the edge of their seats during the final minutes of the game.
Her captivating story had us all on the edge of our seats.
lemma: on the edge of one's seat
source: on the edge of one's seat
